links.outcome: Exam accuracy of LLMs with versus without radiation oncology retrieval-augmented generation
links.effect: RAG improved nonreasoning models (Gemini-2.0 +6.7% to 79.2%, Llama-3-70b +8.4% to 75.8%, GPT-4o +5.7% to 85.6%); top reasoning models showed no improvement or detriment.
links.quote: Gemini-2.0 improved 6.7% (to 79.2%), Llama-3-70b 8.4% (to 75.8%), and GPT-4o 5.7% (to 85.6%) with RAG.

unlisted_practices: Majority voting across multiple LLMs to boost aggregate accuracy
Using reasoning models versus RAG with nonreasoning models as a cost-efficiency tradeoff

screen.practice: retrieval grounding (RAG) added to existing LLMs
screen.reason: Evaluated the effect of adding retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to existing LLMs on radiation oncology exam question performance.
